items.scriptOutline:
【動画・記事の完全論説・網羅的詳細】：
This is only the 2nd time I got a 5 out 5 for an Echo since the day I started playing this game (I don't use Transducers). But people will never get this lucky for even a 3 out 5, just because the Transducers are so trash. I still don't understand why players are not rioting for Wuwa to fix this damn tool. It's the bottom of bottom QOLs. This is the type of things we should be fighting for. Asking Kuro to make this game RNG better. Transducers won't help just min max if they are given a different way or if they guarantees something at least. They could literally make farming less painful than it is already. Once again, it's not just about min maxxing. It's about improving our RNG experience.    submitted by    /u/Muted-Country3708   [link]   [個のコメント]
